REGION        Southwest Iceland
BEST WINDOW   Late September, or early March
INTENSITY     Low

WHY

south coast and the Golden Circle are both day trips from here.

I hate crowded places. Where in Japan?

DESTINATION ANALYSIS

AVOID         Kyoto centre, Tokyo at weekends, anything in cherry season
TOHOKU        Northern, mountainous, very low foreign traffic
SANIN COAST   Western coastline, reachable and largely empty
NAOSHIMA      Art islands, capped by ferry capacity

WHY
Japan's crowding is concentrated in about six places. Twenty kilometres
away it disappears.

DESTINATION ANALYSIS

REGION        Iceland
BEST WINDOW   Late September, or early March
INTENSITY     Medium

WHY
Both give aurora nights and still leave enough daylight to drive and
shoot. Midsummer has no darkness; December has four usable hours.

NOTE
Avoid December if you intend to drive.

Tokyo or Kyoto for photography?

COMPARISON

TOKYO         Night, neon, density, street. Best after dark.
KYOTO         Texture, temples, wood, seasonal colour. Best at dawn.

RECOMMENDATION
Kyoto, if you can start before sunrise. The known locations are unusable
by 09:00 in any season. Tokyo, if you shoot at night.

DESTINATION ANALYSIS

REGION        Southern Chile and Argentina
SEASON        Late spring
INTENSITY     High

WHY
Long daylight and open trails, before the December crowds. Wind is the
defining condition rather than temperature.

NOTE
Weather changes hour to hour in any season. Plan spare days, not spare
clothes.

INTENSITY     Low

PHU QUOC      Under two hours, no visa question, quietest beaches

RECOMMENDATION
Phu Quoc for six days. Krabi spends a day of the six getting there.

Is $500 enough for a week in Vietnam?

BUDGET ESTIMATE

ACCOMMODATION The dominant variable.
TRANSPORT     Buses and trains are cheap. Internal flights are what break
              a low budget.
FOOD          Minor at this level.

RECOMMENDATION
Excluding flights, workable. One internal flight per week keeps it so;
three do not.

DAY 02        Hongdae, Yeonnam, Han River park

REGION        East Asia, short haul
DURATION FIT  4 days suits one city, no internal transfers
INTENSITY     Medium

TAIPEI        Night markets, three hours, cheapest of the three

RECOMMENDATION

in transit.

COMPARISON

SEOUL         Larger, faster, strong design and nightlife.
TAIPEI        Smaller, cheaper, easier to walk, better day trips.

RECOMMENDATION
Taipei for a first trip. A compact city is a better introduction than a
large one when you are learning how you travel.

REGION        Southern Chile and Argentina
DURATION FIT  14 days is the minimum, not a generous allocation
INTENSITY     High

WHY
Distances are the constraint. El Chalten to Torres del Paine is a full
day of ground transport plus a border crossing.

RECOMMENDATION
Worth it at 14 days. Below 10 you spend the trip in transit.
